name: Gandanta Moon — synthetic
source: Synthetic edge case for the Pisces-Aries gandanta zone. Located via daily/hour sweep of January 1990 at Bangalore noon-window.
structural_notes: Bangalore baseline location. At this birth-moment the sidereal Moon falls at ~357.05 deg (Pisces 27.05 deg, Revati nakshatra pada 4) — inside the Pisces-Aries gandanta zone (Pisces 26 deg 40 min - 30 deg 00 min). Exercises gandanta handling. Per Section 11 prediction-trap ban, no outcome assertions about real life events.
